presentation.shortSummaryZh:
刺杀面板会随探索逐步解锁，促使玩家反思支线顺序与决策逻辑。

我认为它在开放世界重复体验和任务信息组织上做了不少值得研究的交互尝试。

reflection.whyPlayedZh: 它争议很大，又以日本为核心背景。我很感兴趣欧美团队如何处理亚洲文化，因此主动去体验。
reflection.whyPlayedEn: It was very controversial, and it's set in Japan. I was curious how a Western studio would handle Asian culture, so I went in to experience it for myself.
reflection.strengthsZh: 刺杀面板会随探索逐步解锁，促使玩家反思支线顺序与决策逻辑。刺杀面板不是固定模板，而像一张逐步展开的空白画布，玩家先遇到的故事和刺杀团体会优先进入自己的信息结构。四季变化也真正改变了重复走同一路线时的感受，风、雪、落叶让相同空间产生不同体验。
reflection.strengthsEn: The assassination board unlocks gradually through exploration, which pushes players to reflect on side-quest order and their own decision logic. It isn't a fixed template — it's more like a blank canvas that unfolds gradually, where whichever stories and assassination targets a player encounters first are the ones that enter their own information structure first. The seasonal changes also genuinely change how it feels to walk the same route again — wind, snow, and falling leaves make the same space feel different each time.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 自由度主要集中在设计好的道路和任务空间，进入山野后探索反馈明显减弱。日本本土地理条件下的野生动物和生态存在感也不足。重复返回已经清理过的地点执行后续刺杀任务，会和玩家主动探索的心理产生冲突。
reflection.weaknessesEn: Freedom is mostly concentrated in the designed roads and quest spaces — once you head into the wilderness, exploration feedback drops off noticeably. Wildlife and ecological presence also feel thin given Japan's actual geography. Having to return repeatedly to locations you've already cleared for follow-up assassination missions also runs against the instinct to keep exploring on your own.
reflection.contributionZh: 动态信息解锁比固定模板更能强化玩家的探索参与感。它让我看到技术迭代真正有价值的方向之一，是让同一空间中的重复行为产生不同体验；同时也让我重新思考开放世界为什么需要给“再次回来”一个新的理由。
reflection.contributionEn: Dynamic information unlocking reinforces a player's sense of participation in exploration more than a fixed template does. It showed me one genuinely valuable direction for technical iteration: making repeated actions in the same space produce different experiences. It also made me rethink why open worlds need to give players a new reason to "come back again."

stats.completionStatusZh: 主线宝可梦全完成全收集

presentation.shortSummaryZh:
开放世界结构通过等级能力锁控制节奏，同时保留自由捕捉和探索期待。

这是我第一次深入玩的宝可梦正传，我最感兴趣的是它如何用能力锁让开放世界产生再次回访的理由。

reflection.strengthsZh: 开放世界结构通过等级能力锁控制节奏，同时保留自由捕捉和探索期待。前期很多高台、水域等区域无法直接到达，随着后续移动能力解锁，玩家可以重新理解已经经过的空间。能力锁让重复跑图不只是重复路线，而是获得新的可达性。
reflection.strengthsEn: The open-world structure paces itself through level-gated movement abilities while still preserving free-form catching and exploration. Early on, many high platforms and bodies of water can't be reached directly; as movement abilities unlock later, players get to reinterpret spaces they've already passed through. The ability gates turn revisiting the map from repeating a route into gaining new access.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 我的主要批评不是针对这款游戏本身，而是借它对比一些开放世界：如果任务只是让玩家回到已经清理过的地点重复执行相似内容，会和主动探索的心理产生冲突。
reflection.weaknessesEn: My main criticism isn't really aimed at this game specifically — I'm using it to compare against open worlds in general: if quests just send players back to already-cleared locations to repeat similar content, that runs against the instinct to keep exploring on your own.
reflection.contributionZh: 能力门槛可以在不破坏自由感的前提下，柔性引导玩家推进主线。它让我更重视技能锁在开放世界中的价值。限制不一定减少自由，反而可以让玩家在获得新能力后重新认识旧地图，从而提高重复探索的意义。
reflection.contributionEn: Ability gates can softly guide players through the main story without breaking their sense of freedom. It made me value skill gating in open worlds more. A limitation doesn't necessarily reduce freedom — it can instead let players see an old map in a new light once they gain a new ability, which gives revisiting real meaning.

presentation.shortSummaryZh:
白天经营羁绊、夜晚潜入战斗的双线结构形成了强节奏感。

我认为它把伙伴交往、技能收益和人格心理学结合得很有辨识度。

reflection.strengthsZh: 白天经营羁绊、夜晚潜入战斗的双线结构形成了强节奏感。部分伙伴关系会解锁很具体的机制能力，因此沟通不只是看剧情，也会形成明确的体验目的。心理学和人格主题也让角色成长不只是数值成长，而涉及人生阶段、死亡和内心追求。
reflection.strengthsEn: The dual-track structure — building bonds by day, infiltrating and fighting by night — creates a strong sense of pacing. Some relationships unlock very concrete mechanical abilities, so talking to a character isn't just about the story, it also has a clear gameplay purpose. The psychological and personality themes also make character growth about more than stats — it touches on life stages, death, and inner pursuit.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 后期宫殿和相关流程对我来说会逐渐重复。
reflection.weaknessesEn: For me, the later palaces and their surrounding process start to feel repetitive.
reflection.contributionZh: 它把荣格心理学概念转化为角色、迷宫和成长系统，是思想表达与玩法结构结合的参考。它让我看到伙伴系统如果能和机制收益结合，社交就不会只是附属剧情；同时我也很在意游戏是否能真正把心理或哲学主题放进系统体验，而不是只停留在台词层面。
reflection.contributionEn: It translates Jungian psychology into characters, dungeons, and a growth system, which makes it a reference for combining thematic expression with gameplay structure. It showed me that if a bond system is tied to real mechanical payoff, socializing stops being a side story. I also pay close attention to whether a game can genuinely bring a psychological or philosophical theme into its system-level experience, rather than leaving it at the level of dialogue.

presentation.shortSummaryZh:
长期角色关系和选择后果共同构成强烈的科幻叙事沉浸。

我本身并不特别迷恋太空题材，但我喜欢它把文明放大后产生的群体冲突和身份立场。

reflection.strengthsZh: 太空背景让个人不再只是个人，而经常成为一个文明、组织或群体的代表，这使文明冲突被放大。我喜欢观察这种关系变化。多数箱庭和探索空间也能不断产生新的发现感。战斗中队友技能可以真正进入策略判断，让团队协作成为战斗系统的一部分。
reflection.strengthsEn: The space setting means an individual is rarely just an individual — they often stand in for a civilization, an organization, or a group, which amplifies the sense of civilizational conflict. I like watching those relationships shift. Most of the sandbox-style and exploration spaces also keep delivering a sense of discovery. In combat, squadmates' abilities genuinely factor into strategic decisions, making teamwork part of the combat system itself.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 部分线性探索和剧情段落会显得比较枯燥。
reflection.weaknessesEn: Some of the more linear exploration and story segments can feel dull.
reflection.contributionZh: 队友关系和世界状态变化是持续投入的重要来源。它强化了我对团队战斗设计的兴趣：角色差异不一定只靠个人技能模组体现，也可以让队友能力真正进入我的即时策略。
reflection.contributionEn: Squadmate relationships and the way the world's state shifts are a major source of sustained engagement. It strengthened my interest in team-combat design: character differences don't have to come only from individual skill modules — a teammate's abilities can genuinely factor into my real-time strategy.

detail.zh: 我喜欢它在文明冲突和团队战斗上的处理。相比单纯强化主角，我更在意队友技能如何改变我的选择。我觉得这种协作比加入大量暂停和指令层更有趣，因为它仍然能保持实时战斗的连续性。
detail.en: I like how it handles civilizational conflict and squad combat. Rather than simply making the protagonist stronger, I care more about how my squadmates' abilities change my choices in the moment. I find this kind of cooperation more interesting than piling on pause menus and command layers, because it still keeps real-time combat continuous.

presentation.shortSummaryZh:
探索、资源采集和基地建设形成稳定的地下世界循环。

我非常喜欢它让多人团队中的成员自然发展出不同职责，而不是强制职业划分。

reflection.strengthsZh: 探索、资源采集和基地建设形成稳定的地下世界循环。玩家可以根据性格和游玩偏好形成探索、战斗、制造等不同成长方向，而且对应行为会继续强化自己的能力。团队成员之间因此能拉开真正有意义的差异。
reflection.strengthsEn: Exploration, resource gathering, and base building form a stable underground-world loop. Players can grow in different directions — exploration, combat, crafting — based on their own personality and preferences, and those behaviors keep reinforcing their own abilities. That lets teammates develop genuinely meaningful differences from each other.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 很多合作游戏会把制造、战斗等系统绑得太紧，导致所有人最终都必须平均参与每一种活动。我认为这种相互制约更适合单人设计，不适合强调多人分工的系统。
reflection.weaknessesEn: A lot of co-op games tie systems like crafting and combat together too tightly, which forces everyone to end up spread evenly across every activity. I think that kind of mutual constraint suits single-player design better — it doesn't suit a system meant to emphasize division of labor among multiple players.
reflection.contributionZh: 轻量生存系统可以通过空间扩张和资源目标持续制造探索动力。它让我更明确地认为多人系统应该允许成员形成极端优势和真实分工，而不是为了保证单人完整性把所有人压回平均体验。
reflection.contributionEn: A lightweight survival system can keep generating motivation to explore through spatial expansion and resource goals. It made me more convinced that multiplayer systems should let members develop real strengths and a genuine division of labor, instead of flattening everyone back into an average experience just to preserve single-player completeness.

presentation.shortSummaryZh:
时间管理和角色成长结构形成持续推进压力。

我不觉得它的塔是单纯重复，而是一个会随着玩家成长不断加速、不断改变心理感受的循环。

reflection.strengthsZh: 时间管理和角色成长结构形成持续推进压力。随着强度提升，怪物会从威胁变成主动躲避玩家的对象，玩家对塔的心理也会从谨慎变成主动重复进入。相比P5相对线性的地下探索，我更愿意反复回到塔的中间节点。3D与2D界面的融合也非常成熟。
reflection.strengthsEn: The time-management and character-growth structure keeps up steady pressure to progress. As the player gets stronger, monsters go from being a threat to something that actively avoids the player, and the player's own attitude toward the tower shifts from caution to actively wanting to go back in. Compared to Persona 5's more linear dungeon exploration, I much prefer repeatedly returning to the tower's middle floors. The blend of 3D and 2D interface is also very mature.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 重复爬塔本身仍然可能让部分玩家觉得枯燥，体验是否成立很依赖成长速度和重复内容的变化。
reflection.weaknessesEn: Repeatedly climbing the tower can still feel tedious to some players — whether the experience holds up depends heavily on the pace of growth and how much the repeated content actually varies.
reflection.contributionZh: 有限日程可以强化选择重量，但也需要控制玩家焦虑。它让我意识到重复结构本身并不一定是问题，关键是同一个循环能否随着玩家成长改变速度、风险和心理感受。
reflection.contributionEn: A limited in-game calendar can give choices more weight, but it also needs to keep player anxiety in check. It made me realize a repeated structure isn't inherently a problem — what matters is whether the same loop can change its pace, risk, and emotional feel as the player grows.

detail.zh: 我觉得P3把“重复进入同一座塔”做成了不断加速的成长体验。玩家会主动回到中间层，而不是只想着一次性走到终点。这种循环感甚至让我觉得比很多刻意做随机性的肉鸽结构更有吸引力。
detail.en: I feel Persona 3 turns "repeatedly entering the same tower" into a growth experience that keeps accelerating. Players actively return to the middle floors instead of only thinking about reaching the top in one go. That sense of the loop actually feels more compelling to me than a lot of roguelike structures built deliberately around randomness.

presentation.shortSummaryZh:
服饰系统和魔法世界观沉浸感出色，但后期内容同质化明显。

它最吸引我的地方，是把“魔法”真正拆成一套可成长、可组合、可形成连招的战斗语言。

reflection.strengthsZh: 服饰系统和魔法世界观沉浸感出色，但后期内容同质化明显。魔法特效和技能组合很有表现力，装备系统也真正进入换装体验，不只是数值表格。不同魔法之间能形成明显的战斗组合。
reflection.strengthsEn: The outfit system and the sense of immersion in the magical world are excellent, though late-game content becomes noticeably repetitive. The magic effects and skill combinations are very expressive, and the gear system genuinely feeds into the dress-up experience rather than just being a stat sheet. Different spells can also form clear combat combos with each other.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 后期内容重复感很强，地下空间资源复用明显，魔法套路也会逐渐固定。数值碾压后，战斗的策略性和刺激感都会下降。
reflection.weaknessesEn: Late-game content feels quite repetitive — underground spaces clearly reuse the same resources, and spell patterns settle into a fixed routine. Once your stats outpace the content, combat loses both its strategic depth and its excitement.
reflection.contributionZh: 开放地图需要更强的探索动线和关卡节奏，否则容易在后期失去新鲜感。它让我更关注主题语言如何转化成系统语言：魔法不是只换一套特效，而是需要形成自己的技能组合和成长逻辑。
reflection.contributionEn: An open map needs a stronger exploration flow and level pacing, or it easily loses its novelty in the late game. It made me pay closer attention to how a theme's language gets translated into a system's language: magic shouldn't just be a different set of visual effects — it needs its own skill combinations and growth logic.

stats.completionStatusZh: 1.0版本时曾完成当时的全成就；之后版本内容仍在继续体验

presentation.shortSummaryZh:
经营管线、帕鲁词条和战斗搭配共同构成深层成长循环。

我很认可它对团队成长和个人成长的平衡，尤其是多人环境中每个人可以自然承担不同方向。

reflection.strengthsZh:
经营管线、帕鲁词条和战斗搭配共同构成深层成长循环。

建造、工厂、战斗等方向可以让不同玩家承担不同责任，团队成长不会完全压在同一个人身上。它把沙盒系统之间的关系组织得很成熟。
reflection.strengthsEn:
Production pipelines, Pal traits, and combat team-building together form a deep growth loop.

Directions like building, factories, and combat let different players take on different responsibilities, so team progress doesn't fall entirely on one person. It organizes the relationships between its sandbox systems in a very mature way.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 玩家回归体验不够好。重新开荒意味着重新面对熟悉地图和帕鲁，即使提高经验倍率，也会让我担心错过内容，同时又不愿重复完整旅程。
reflection.weaknessesEn: The returning-player experience isn't good enough. Starting over means facing a map and Pals you already know; even with a higher experience multiplier, I'd still worry about missing content while also not wanting to repeat the whole journey.
reflection.contributionZh:
它真正可借鉴的不只是“帕鲁形象”，而是生蛋、词条、生产和战斗之间的复合循环。

它让我开始关注长线沙盒的“回归设计”：快速追赶不能只是倍率提高，还要考虑如何减少重复劳动又不让玩家觉得跳过了游戏。
reflection.contributionEn:
What's genuinely worth learning from it isn't just the "Pal" designs — it's the compound loop between breeding, traits, production, and combat.

It got me thinking about "return design" for long-running sandbox games: catching players up quickly can't just mean a higher multiplier — it also has to consider how to cut repetitive labor without making players feel like they skipped the game.

detail.zh: 我喜欢它让团队内部自然形成建造、工厂和战斗等不同责任。真正让我后期犹豫的是回归成本：我已经知道地图和大部分帕鲁，再次开荒对我来说缺少新鲜动力。
detail.en: I like how it naturally lets a team split into different responsibilities — building, running factories, fighting. What really made me hesitate later on was the cost of returning: since I already know the map and most of the Pals, starting over from scratch didn't offer me much fresh motivation.

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 多武器模组让重复战斗场景保持变化，剧情演出也具备细腻呼吸感。

reflection.strengthsZh: 多武器模组让重复战斗场景保持变化，剧情演出也具备细腻呼吸感。
reflection.strengthsEn: The multi-weapon modules keep repeated combat scenes feeling varied, and the story's cinematic presentation has a delicate sense of breathing room.
reflection.contributionZh: 微表情和轻微镜头变化很适合优化站桩对话类演出。
reflection.contributionEn: Subtle facial expressions and small camera shifts work well for polishing static, stand-and-talk dialogue scenes.

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 触屏操作空间大，玩法核心至今没有同类平替。

reflection.whyPlayedZh: 触屏操作 / 玩法核心
reflection.strengthsZh: 触屏操作空间大，玩法核心至今没有同类平替。
reflection.strengthsEn: There's a lot of room in its touch controls, and its core gameplay still has no real substitute among similar games.
reflection.contributionZh: 它的优势在于触屏手感和玩法操作深度，但长期活动模板化和角色次抛会削弱内容生命力。
reflection.contributionEn: Its strength is the feel of its touch controls and the depth of its core gameplay, but templated long-term events and lower-tier character releases wear down its content's lifespan.

stats.playtimeLabelEn: 付费测试 + 开服至今

presentation.shortSummaryZh:
强美术和产品进化潜力突出，但当前活动仍常停留在 2D 入口 + 3D 关卡的迁移思路。

我认可市场需要真正为女性设计游戏，但我不认为把“女性”等同于甜美、可爱和迪士尼式幻想就等于站在女性视角。

reflection.whyPlayedZh: 多端转型 / 内外循环
reflection.whyPlayedEn: Cross-Platform Transition / Inner and Outer Loop
reflection.strengthsZh:
强美术和产品进化潜力突出，但当前活动仍常停留在 2D 入口 + 3D 关卡的迁移思路。

它证明了女性向大世界和换装体验存在真实市场需求，也持续投入了视觉和音乐制作。
reflection.strengthsEn:
Strong art and clear potential for the product to keep evolving stand out, though current events still often stay at the level of a 2D entry point migrated onto a 3D level.

It proves there's real market demand for a female-oriented open world combined with a dress-up experience, and it keeps investing in visuals and music.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 我认为它对女性需求的理解仍然带有明显刻板印象，服装和整体表达过度集中在甜美、可爱路线。社区运营也经常让讨论跳出游戏本体，利用玩家之间的竞争和争论制造话题。
reflection.weaknessesEn: I think its understanding of what women want still carries clear stereotypes — the outfits and overall expression concentrate too heavily on a sweet, cute style. Community management also often pushes discussion outside the game itself, using competition and arguments between players to generate buzz.
reflection.contributionZh:
核心问题是剧情玩法内循环与氪金社区外循环割裂，活动需要更多与已有成长系统交错的内容。

它让我更明确地区分“面向女性市场”和“站在女性视角设计”。前者可以靠视觉符号完成，后者需要真正理解女性玩家的主体性、审美差异和行为需求。
reflection.contributionEn:
The core problem is that the story-and-gameplay inner loop is disconnected from the spending-and-community outer loop; events need more content that actually interlocks with the existing growth systems.

It made me draw a clearer distinction between "targeting the women's market" and "designing from a woman's perspective." The former can be achieved through visual symbols alone; the latter requires genuinely understanding women players' agency, aesthetic differences, and behavioral needs.

detail.zh: 我从开服玩到现在，最大的感受并不是女性游戏有没有市场，而是女性市场不能被简化成一种统一审美。我会特别关注它如何定义“女性喜欢什么”，以及这种定义是否最后又回到了行业刻板印象。
detail.en: Having played since launch, my biggest takeaway isn't about whether games for women have a market — it's that the women's market can't be reduced to a single unified aesthetic. I pay particular attention to how it defines "what women like," and whether that definition ends up circling back to industry stereotypes anyway.

stats.completionStatusZh: 目前完成了两个博物馆路线

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我觉得它在镜头、旋转、物体编辑等基础建造交互上非常成熟，但成长信息对前期规划的支持不够。

reflection.strengthsZh: 镜头旋转、物体旋转和编辑模式整体非常顺手，这套交互很值得参考到其他建造或布局游戏。
reflection.strengthsEn: Camera rotation, object rotation, and the overall edit mode feel very smooth to use — this interaction set is well worth referencing in other building or layout games.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 前期玩家不知道未来还会解锁多少空间，容易在当前区域投入大量精细规划后发现后续扩建把原来的设计逻辑推翻。任务对满意度、进度或员工结构的要求也可能迫使玩家反复换人，破坏已经建立的长期关系和经营框架。不同博物馆虽然主题不同，但基础套路仍比较相似。
reflection.weaknessesEn: Early on, players don't know how much more space will eventually unlock, so it's easy to invest heavily in fine-grained planning for the current area, only to have a later expansion overturn that original design logic. Objectives around satisfaction, progress, or staff structure can also force players to keep swapping people out, breaking down long-term relationships and management structures they'd already built. Different museums, despite having different themes, still end up following fairly similar underlying patterns.
reflection.contributionZh: 它让我意识到建造类游戏不能只把扩建当奖励，未来空间信息本身也会影响玩家是否敢认真布局；系统如果事后推翻玩家前期投入，会产生很强的阻断感。
reflection.contributionEn: It made me realize building games can't treat expansion purely as a reward — information about future space itself affects whether players dare to plan seriously. If a system later overturns a player's earlier investment, it creates a strong sense of being cut off.

detail.zh: 我会把它的编辑交互作为正面案例，但会把成长信息披露作为反面案例。对我来说，最大的挫败不是空间变大，而是我之前认真设计好的东西突然因为未知扩建而显得像白做了。
detail.en: I'd hold up its editing interactions as a positive example, but its disclosure of growth information as a negative one. For me, the biggest frustration wasn't the space getting bigger — it was that something I'd carefully designed suddenly felt wasted because of an expansion I had no way of anticipating.

identity.canonicalTitle: 飞升民宿（语音转写未确认）
identity.titleEn: 飞升民宿（语音转写未确认）

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我非常喜欢它的关卡连通方式，地图可以通过反复跑动逐渐记住，而且不会带来太高的探索心理压力。

reflection.strengthsZh: 深入区域后经常能打开一扇门重新连接到之前探索过的地点，这种捷径和回环结构让地图很连贯，也显著降低了重复跑图压力。
reflection.strengthsEn: Deep inside an area, you can often open a door that reconnects to somewhere you've already explored — this kind of shortcut-and-loop structure keeps the map coherent and significantly reduces the burden of backtracking.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 怪物种类较少，支线内容比较单一，长时间体验后重复感明显。
reflection.weaknessesEn: There aren't many enemy types, and the side content is fairly uniform — after extended play, the repetition becomes noticeable.
reflection.contributionZh: 如果我要专门研究关卡设计，我会把它作为拆解对象，因为它很好地展示了如何通过回环、捷径和空间记忆降低探索负担。
reflection.contributionEn: If I were studying level design specifically, I'd pick this apart as a case study, because it demonstrates so well how loops, shortcuts, and spatial memory can reduce the burden of exploration.

detail.zh: 我认为它把箱庭和连续地图的优点结合得很好。玩家不是靠地图标记硬记路线，而是在重复经过和打开新通路的过程中形成空间记忆。
detail.en: I think it combines the strengths of garden-style level design and a continuous map very well. Players don't memorize routes by relying on map markers — they build spatial memory through repeatedly passing through and opening up new paths.

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我把它看作多人模拟、战斗、探索和剧情结合得非常完整的案例，尤其是建造真正承担了生存功能。

reflection.strengthsZh: 建造不是装饰性副系统。昆虫会攻击家园，因此墙体、防御、制造台位置都需要被认真考虑。材料升级也会直接改变基地的防御强度，从树叶墙到更坚硬的墙体，玩家能感觉到整个据点在成长。
reflection.strengthsEn: Building isn't a decorative side system. Insects attack your home, so wall placement, defenses, and crafting-station positions all need to be considered carefully. Material upgrades also directly change the base's defensive strength — going from leaf walls to sturdier ones, players can feel the whole outpost growing stronger.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 我体验中比较明显的问题是优化较差。
reflection.weaknessesEn: The most noticeable issue in my experience was poor optimization.
reflection.contributionZh: 它让我更明确地区分“有建造功能”和“建造真正参与核心循环”。只有当建造影响防御、制造和团队生存时，我才会觉得它不是为了照顾建造爱好者额外塞进去的系统。
reflection.contributionEn: It made me draw a clearer distinction between "having a building feature" and "building genuinely being part of the core loop." I only feel building isn't just an extra system tacked on for building enthusiasts when it actually affects defense, crafting, and the team's survival.

detail.zh: 我很喜欢它让基地本身和玩家一起变强。很多游戏的建造只是资源消耗或装饰，而这里的空间布局、材料和功能都和真实风险发生关系，所以我在建造时会持续思考。
detail.en: I really like how it lets the base itself grow stronger alongside the player. In a lot of games, building is just a resource sink or decoration, but here the layout, materials, and function are all tied to real risk, so I keep thinking while I build.

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我最认可的是它把敌人本身转化成玩家技能来源，让击败Boss和精英怪之后的记忆继续存在于战斗系统里。

reflection.strengthsZh: 变身和精魄类能力让Boss、精英怪不只是一次性遭遇，而会成为后续技能组合的一部分。这让学习敌人的过程和角色成长发生了直接联系。
reflection.strengthsEn: Transformation and spirit-type abilities mean bosses and elite enemies aren't just one-off encounters — they become part of your later skill combinations. That creates a direct link between learning an enemy and growing your own character.
reflection.contributionZh: 它让我看到技能成长不一定只是“拿到新武器或新特效”，也可以把曾经遭遇过的敌人转化成玩家自身能力，从而让内容复用具有叙事和记忆价值。
reflection.contributionEn: It showed me that skill growth doesn't have to mean just "getting a new weapon or new effect" — an enemy you've previously fought can be turned into an ability of your own, which gives reused content real narrative and memory value.

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我很喜欢它如何随着玩家能力提升不断重新定义空间边界，同时逐步推进玩家对机构和异常事件的情绪认知。

reflection.strengthsZh: 叙事上从最初的不理解逐渐进入机构内部，玩家会一步步看到工作人员如何冷漠地对待异常和实验对象。关卡上，随着远程操控、漂浮等能力解锁，原本只能远远看到的空间会逐渐变成可到达区域。
reflection.strengthsEn: Narratively, it moves from initial confusion into deeper access inside the Bureau, and players gradually see how coldly the staff treats anomalies and test subjects. In terms of level design, as abilities like telekinesis and levitation unlock, spaces you could once only see from a distance gradually become reachable.
reflection.contributionZh: 它是我以后很想拆解的关卡案例，因为它展示了如何在玩家移动能力不断扩张时，仍然精确控制可达高度、视线和空间揭示节奏。
reflection.contributionEn: It's a level-design case I'd love to dissect in more depth someday, because it shows how to precisely control reachable height, sightlines, and the pacing of spatial reveal even as the player's movement abilities keep expanding.

detail.zh: 我喜欢它让玩家能力和关卡理解同步成长。玩家还不能飞时只能看到某些提示，真正获得能力后才会看见完整空间，这种尺度控制让我觉得非常成熟。
detail.en: I like how it grows the player's abilities and their understanding of the level in sync. Before you can fly, you only see certain hints; once you actually gain the ability, you see the full space. That sense of controlled scale feels very mature to me.

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我认为它非常值得学习的一点，是把“抓宝可梦”这个既定目标重新拆成了完全不同的交互形式。

reflection.strengthsZh: 它没有把宝可梦生态继续限制在捕捉，而是通过建造生态区域吸引宝可梦来生活，让“获得宝可梦”变成共建环境后的结果。系统目标没有消失，但行为表达变得更符合共同生活的世界观。
reflection.strengthsEn: It doesn't keep the Pokémon ecosystem confined to catching — instead, you build habitat zones to attract Pokémon to live there, turning "acquiring a Pokémon" into the outcome of building an environment together. The system goal hasn't disappeared, but the behavior expressing it now fits a "living together" worldview much better.
reflection.contributionZh: 它让我确认一个设计原则：单一体验目标可以被拆成完全不同的交互形式，不必总是沿用行业已经习惯的机制。只要目标和反馈仍然成立，甚至可以借此改变整个玩法的攻击性和世界观表达。
reflection.contributionEn: It confirmed a design principle for me: a single experience goal can be expressed through completely different interaction forms — it doesn't always have to reuse the mechanics the industry is used to. As long as the goal and its feedback still hold up, you can even use that to change how aggressive the whole gameplay feels and how it expresses its worldview.

detail.zh: 我很喜欢它重新解释“捕捉”这件事。玩家仍然需要让宝可梦来到自己的世界，但方式变成建设适合它们居住的生态，这比直接套用传统捕捉机制更让我觉得系统和世界观是一体的。
detail.en: I really like how it reinterprets "catching." Players still need to bring Pokémon into their own world, but the method becomes building an ecosystem they'd want to live in — which makes the system and the setting feel far more unified to me than just applying the traditional catching mechanic directly.

identity.titleZh: 宝可梦传说 阿尔宙斯

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我喜欢它把宝可梦生态、箱庭地图和更即时的行动结合起来。

reflection.strengthsZh: 不同地图区域有明显生态差异，玩家很容易形成“哪些宝可梦住在哪里”的空间记忆。重复跑图时仍有收集和探索目标，因此不会完全失去意义。
reflection.strengthsEn: Different map areas have clear ecological differences, so players easily build spatial memory around "which Pokémon live where." There are still collection and exploration goals when revisiting an area, so it never entirely loses its meaning.
reflection.contributionZh: 它让我看到生态设计可以直接成为地图识别系统：玩家不只是记地形，也会通过生物分布记住区域。
reflection.contributionEn: It showed me that ecological design can function directly as a map-recognition system: players don't just remember the terrain, they also remember an area through where its creatures live.

detail.zh: 我很喜欢它让每块箱庭有自己的生态特征。宝可梦的栖息分布和收集目标会帮助我记住地图，因此反复进入同一区域时仍然能获得方向感和目标感。
detail.en: I really like how each garden-style area has its own ecological character. The distribution of Pokémon habitats and collection goals help me remember the map, so re-entering the same area still gives me a sense of direction and purpose.

identity.canonicalTitle: 逆转裁判123 成步堂精选集
identity.titleZh: 逆转裁判123 成步堂精选集

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我认为它成功解决了视觉小说“游戏感弱”的问题，把证据、调查和庭审压力真正做成了交互节奏。

reflection.strengthsZh: 提交证据、现场调查和庭审中的错误惩罚共同制造紧张感。信息不是只靠阅读推进，而是需要玩家在限定情境中做判断。
reflection.strengthsEn: Presenting evidence, on-scene investigation, and the penalty for a wrong move in court all work together to create tension. Information doesn't advance through reading alone — players have to make judgment calls within a constrained situation.
reflection.contributionZh: 它让我很明确地区分“剧情有紧张感”和“交互本身制造紧张感”。我更认可后者，因为玩法、信息和节奏被真正结合在一起。
reflection.contributionEn: It gave me a clear way to distinguish between "the story has tension" and "the interaction itself creates tension." I'm more convinced by the latter, because gameplay, information, and pacing are genuinely tied together.

detail.zh: 很多视觉小说会用冗长支线或单纯靠剧情制造波折，但我觉得《逆转裁判》更有效，因为错误提交证据会产生明确压力，调查又限制你掌握信息的方式，玩家必须真正参与推理节奏。
detail.en: A lot of visual novels create tension through lengthy side content or by leaning purely on the story, but I find Ace Attorney more effective: submitting the wrong evidence creates clear, immediate pressure, and the investigation phase constrains how you gather information, so players genuinely have to engage with the pace of deduction.

identity.canonicalTitle: 宝可梦晶灿钻石／明亮珍珠
identity.titleZh: 宝可梦晶灿钻石／明亮珍珠
identity.titleEn: 宝可梦晶灿钻石／明亮珍珠

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我最喜欢的是挖矿玩法，它用很简单的2D交互做出了非常强的操作真实感。

reflection.strengthsZh: 挖矿本身的反馈很有吸引力，也能为收集和其他长期目标提供额外动力。虽然视觉表达很简单，但操作过程让我觉得很有“在挖东西”的真实感。
reflection.strengthsEn: The feedback from mining itself is engaging on its own, and it also gives collecting and other long-term goals extra motivation. The visuals are simple, but the act of doing it genuinely feels like "digging for something."
reflection.contributionZh: 它让我意识到真实感并不依赖复杂3D表现，简单的2D交互只要反馈结构正确，也可以产生很强的身体感和操作满足。
reflection.contributionEn: It made me realize a sense of realism doesn't depend on complex 3D presentation — a simple 2D interaction, as long as its feedback structure is right, can still produce a strong sense of physicality and satisfaction from the action itself.

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我把它和《逆转裁判》放在一起看，都是把视觉小说中的信息判断真正转换成玩法。

reflection.strengthsZh: 把证据作为“弹丸”攻击矛盾信息的形式，让信息筛选本身变成操作。唇枪舌战、互相怀疑和节奏推进共同制造心理压力。
reflection.strengthsEn: Turning evidence into "bullets" that attack contradictory statements makes filtering information itself into an action. The verbal sparring, mutual suspicion, and forward pace all combine to create real psychological pressure.
reflection.contributionZh: 它进一步强化了我的判断：视觉小说如果只是阅读剧情，游戏感很容易不足；把证据、冲突和信息筛选转化成可操作机制后，节奏才真正属于玩家。
reflection.contributionEn: It further confirmed something I already believed: if a visual novel is only about reading a story, it easily falls short as a game. Once evidence, conflict, and information filtering are turned into a mechanic the player can act on, the pacing genuinely belongs to the player.

identity.canonicalTitle: 恋与制作人（标题需确认）
identity.titleEn: 恋与制作人（标题需确认）

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 当时最吸引我的是剧情演出节奏和主角群在主线中的表现，它很好地满足了我当时对爱情叙事的幻想。

reflection.whyPlayedZh: 这是我较早真正投入自己时间和情绪的一款手游，也是早期让我持续追主线剧情的恋爱向作品。
reflection.whyPlayedEn: This was one of the earlier mobile games I genuinely invested my time and emotions into, and one of the first romance-oriented titles that kept me following its main story.
reflection.contributionZh: 这段经历让我意识到手游的长期动力有时并不来自复杂系统，而来自持续追剧情和情感关系的愿望。
reflection.contributionEn: That experience made me realize a mobile game's long-term pull doesn't always come from complex systems — sometimes it comes from the desire to keep following a story and an emotional relationship.

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我长期留下来的主要原因仍然是换装本身，但我觉得后期系统越来越冗余，审美也逐渐出现行业同质化。

reflection.strengthsZh: 早期我第一次比较系统地理解卡牌进阶、升级和重复抽取与数值成长之间的关系，换装和养成在一定阶段结合得比较顺。
reflection.strengthsEn: Early on, this was the first time I understood, in a fairly systematic way, the relationship between card advancement, upgrading, repeated draws, and stat growth. At a certain stage, dress-up and progression fit together quite smoothly.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 后期增加的数值和养成系统越来越像常规数值游戏的叠加，和换装核心的关系变弱。微氪金、服装和新技术不断叠加，却没有解决玩法层面的冗余。长期来看我也明显感受到审美资源趋同。
reflection.weaknessesEn: The stat and progression systems added later increasingly stack on top of each other like a standard numbers-driven game, and their connection to the dress-up core weakens. Micro-transactions, outfits, and new tech keep piling up without ever resolving the redundancy at the gameplay level. Over the long run I also noticed the aesthetic resources converging noticeably.
reflection.contributionZh: 它让我开始关注两个问题：系统新增是否真的服务核心体验，以及长期内容生产为什么会因为共享同一批时尚和美术参考而越来越同质化。
reflection.contributionEn: It got me paying attention to two questions: whether a new system actually serves the core experience, and why long-term content production ends up increasingly homogeneous when it keeps drawing from the same pool of fashion and art references.

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我没有长期留下来的一个重要原因是移动端镜头体验和无法跳过剧情对我的负担比较大。

reflection.strengthsZh: 视觉表现本身很好，早期纵深探索也能带来明显的新鲜感。
reflection.strengthsEn: The visuals themselves are excellent, and the early vertical exploration delivers a clear sense of novelty.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 我在平板和手机上很容易产生眩晕，和后来体验《鸣潮》相比，我怀疑问题来自镜头动态速度和操作时视觉动线的延迟感。无法跳过剧情也会长期占用设备。后期大量纵深地图让我跑图非常不愉快。
reflection.weaknessesEn: I get motion sickness easily on tablet and phone. Compared with playing Wuthering Waves later, I suspect the issue comes from the camera's dynamic speed and a sense of delay in the visual flow while playing. Not being able to skip story sequences also ties up the device for long stretches. Later, all the heavily vertical maps made getting around genuinely unpleasant.
reflection.contributionZh: 它让我更加关注跨设备镜头不是简单缩放的问题。即使画面很好，如果镜头响应和人的下意识操作节奏不一致，也会直接影响身体舒适度和长期留存。
reflection.contributionEn: It made me pay much closer attention to cross-device camera work not being a simple matter of scaling. Even with great visuals, if the camera's responsiveness doesn't match a player's instinctive sense of timing, it directly affects physical comfort and long-term retention.

identity.canonicalTitle: 梦幻方法录（语音转写未确认）
identity.titleEn: 梦幻方法录（语音转写未确认）

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 这是我较早沉迷的一款带卡牌、词条和回合策略的手游，我最上头的是速度属性带来的先后手博弈。

reflection.strengthsZh: 卡牌、词条和成长组合让我很容易进入长期追求。战斗后期对速度的争夺会直接改变先手权，形成非常清晰的策略目标。
reflection.strengthsEn: The combination of cards, stat rolls, and progression makes it easy to get pulled into a long-term pursuit. Late in a fight, the fight for speed directly determines turn order, which gives you a very clear strategic goal.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 当类似机制玩得太多之后，我对同类系统的兴趣明显下降；速度如果成为绝对核心，也容易压缩其他策略空间。
reflection.weaknessesEn: After playing enough similar mechanics, my interest in that kind of system clearly drops. If speed becomes the single dominant factor, it also tends to crowd out other strategic space.
reflection.contributionZh: 它让我第一次非常直观地感受到“行动顺序”本身就可以成为整个回合制系统的核心资源。
reflection.contributionEn: It was the first time I viscerally felt that "turn order" itself can become the core resource of an entire turn-based system.

detail.zh: 我曾经非常沉迷词条和速度博弈。后期我会明显感觉，只要速度比对方快，就能提前建立优势，这让我开始关注回合制系统里速度是否会最终吞掉其他属性的价值。
detail.en: I used to be deeply hooked on stat rolls and the speed metagame. Later on I'd clearly feel that as long as I was faster than my opponent, I could establish an advantage early — which got me watching for whether speed ends up swallowing the value of every other stat in a turn-based system.

stats.completionStatusZh: 双人竞技场曾达到“首席”段位

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我喜欢它的原因是战斗前准备并不能替代战场中的即时判断，对手行为的不确定性让策略一直存在。

reflection.strengthsZh: 双人竞技环境里，即使牌组和前期准备完善，战场上仍然需要不断应对对方行为，这种不确定性让我很投入。
reflection.strengthsEn: In a two-player competitive setting, even with a well-prepared deck and pre-match setup, you still have to keep reacting to your opponent's actions on the battlefield — that uncertainty kept me genuinely engaged.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 强制社团和线下群体关系给我的体验非常差。我曾因为迟到一两分钟没有进入社团活动，被引流到线下群后辱骂并踢出社团，最终因此退游。
reflection.weaknessesEn: Mandatory guilds and the offline group dynamics around them gave me a very bad experience. I was once one or two minutes late to a guild activity, got pushed into an offline group chat, was verbally abused there, and was kicked from the guild — and that's ultimately why I quit.
reflection.contributionZh: 它让我非常警惕把游戏进度和强制社交组织绑定。多人系统可以制造合作，但一旦把资源、活动和固定社群强绑定，也会把现实社交压力带进游戏。
reflection.contributionEn: It made me very wary of tying game progress to mandatory social organizations. Multiplayer systems can create cooperation, but once resources, activities, and a fixed community are forcibly bound together, real-world social pressure gets dragged into the game too.

detail.zh: 我真正喜欢的是竞技本身，因为战场上的策略不能被前期配置完全解决。但我最终离开却不是因为战斗，而是因为强制社团带来的线下社交压力，这对我来说是非常典型的系统副作用。
detail.en: What I genuinely liked was the competitive play itself — the strategy on the battlefield can't be fully solved by pre-match setup. But what ultimately made me leave wasn't the combat — it was the offline social pressure created by mandatory guilds, which to me is a very typical example of a system's side effects.

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我最喜欢的是探索获得物与角色成长之间很顺畅的关系，以及更自由的垂直移动体验。

reflection.strengthsZh: 大世界中看到和获得的内容能够直接进入成长循环，探索因此更有意义。宝藏感知和垂直移动也显著降低了跑图负担，我个人在镜头体验上也比《原神》舒服。
reflection.strengthsEn: What you see and pick up in the open world feeds directly into the growth loop, which makes exploration feel more meaningful. Treasure sensing and vertical movement also cut down noticeably on the burden of getting around, and personally I find the camera more comfortable than in Genshin Impact.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 后期抽卡资源获取压力较大，为了继续抽取需要投入越来越多重复劳动，逐渐降低了我继续玩的动力。
reflection.weaknessesEn: Gacha resource pressure builds up a lot in the late game — keeping up with pulls demands more and more repetitive grinding, which gradually eroded my motivation to keep playing.
reflection.contributionZh: 它让我看到开放世界探索如果能让“我看到什么、得到什么、成长什么”形成直接链路，会比单纯放置收集点更有动力。
reflection.contributionEn: It showed me that when open-world exploration creates a direct chain between "what I see, what I get, and what I grow," it's more motivating than simply scattering collectibles around the map.

detail.zh: 我当时非常上头的一点，就是探索和成长的关系很直接。后来真正让我退出的是抽卡资源压力，而不是地图本身，这让我更关注长线商业系统是否会反过来破坏原本顺畅的探索循环。
detail.en: What really hooked me at the time was how directly exploration connected to growth. What ultimately made me quit wasn't the map itself — it was the pressure of gacha resources, which got me paying closer attention to whether a long-running monetization system ends up undermining an exploration loop that was otherwise smooth.

stats.playtimeLabelZh: 开服后断断续续玩了约三年

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我认为它最大的硬伤一直是本体玩法没有真正改变，后来新增再多小游戏和周期机制，也没有解决核心战斗的单调。

reflection.strengthsZh: 美术和话题度很强，后期也不断尝试通过角色机制、活动小游戏和周期玩法扩展体验。
reflection.strengthsEn: The art and its ability to generate buzz are both strong, and later on it keeps trying to expand the experience through character mechanics, event mini-games, and periodic modes.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 角色虽然尝试通过左右合成、数量、颜色等条件改变卡牌合成，但底层逻辑仍然没有脱离数值战斗。轻度玩家可以被美术和话题吸引，却很难稳定转化成深度玩家。
reflection.weaknessesEn: Characters try to vary card combinations through conditions like left/right pairing, count, and color, but the underlying logic still never really escapes stat-based combat. Casual players can be drawn in by the art and the buzz, but they're hard to reliably convert into deeply invested players.
reflection.contributionZh: 它让我特别关注轻度流量和重度留存之间的区别。一个游戏可以因为美术和话题拥有大量浅层用户，但如果核心玩法没有足够深度，长期商业循环会越来越依赖重复角色和数值刺激。
reflection.contributionEn: It made me pay particular attention to the gap between casual traffic and deep retention. A game can attract a large pool of shallow users through its art and buzz, but if the core gameplay doesn't have enough depth, its long-term monetization loop ends up leaning more and more on repeated character releases and stat-driven stimulation.

detail.zh: 我断断续续玩了很久，也能看到团队在努力加新玩法，但我的感受一直是“外围变了，本体没变”。这让我更关注核心循环是否真的能支撑长期内容，而不是活动数量够不够多。
detail.en: I've played it on and off for a long time, and I can see the team genuinely trying to add new gameplay, but my impression has always been "the periphery changes, the core doesn't." That got me paying more attention to whether a core loop can actually support long-term content, rather than whether there are enough events.

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我认为它更接近多个箱庭连接起来的伪开放世界，前端视觉和交互投入很高，但教程、生产链和建筑功能表达仍有明显压力。

reflection.strengthsZh: 引擎和前端视觉投入非常明显，平面交互和用户体验完成度高。箱庭结构本身也允许进行更细致的关卡设计。
reflection.strengthsEn: The investment in the engine and front-end visuals is clear, and the 2D interactions and overall UX are highly polished. The garden-style structure itself also allows for more detailed level design.
reflection.weaknessesZh: 角色设计对我缺少吸引力，服装和比例带来明显的“手办感”和冗余感。教程虽然很多，却没有很好融入主线流程，需要玩家额外学习。生产资源链后期不断变长，系统不得不再用升级压缩步骤。部分建筑从外观上很难直接判断功能，我认为造型和功能表达存在脱节。
reflection.weaknessesEn: The character designs don't appeal to me — the outfits and proportions give a noticeable "figurine" feel and a sense of excess. There are plenty of tutorials, but they aren't well integrated into the main flow, so players have to learn extra on top. The production resource chain keeps getting longer in the late game, forcing the system to rely on upgrades to compress the steps again. Some buildings are hard to read functionally from their appearance — I think there's a real disconnect between form and function here.
reflection.contributionZh: 它让我重新关注复杂系统的可读性：教程数量多并不等于容易理解，建筑和机器如果无法从形态直接传达用途，长期学习成本会非常高。
reflection.contributionEn: It made me pay renewed attention to the readability of complex systems: having a lot of tutorials doesn't mean a system is easy to understand, and if buildings and machines can't communicate their purpose directly through form, the long-term learning cost gets very high.

detail.zh: 我认可它前端交互的技术完成度，但越深入越能感受到复杂系统对新玩家的心理压力。资源从A到B到C到D的链条如果持续增长，后期再靠压缩流程补救，本身就说明早期系统扩张缺少长期控制。
detail.en: I recognize the technical polish of its front-end interactions, but the deeper you go, the more you feel the psychological pressure a complex system puts on new players. If a resource chain keeps growing from A to B to C to D and later has to be fixed by compressing the process, that itself shows the early system expansion lacked long-term control.

stats.playtimeLabelZh: 语音中提到近期约80小时，但表述不够清晰

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我喜欢这种团队协作的重要性高于纯射击准度的英雄对战，也很重视角色外形、性格和技能机制之间的一致性。

reflection.strengthsZh: 长枪位的准度会加分，但团队协作比单纯枪法更重要，因此不会因为某项操作能力不够成熟就完全被排除。角色设计也能通过体型、比例、姿态和技能直接传达性格与机制。
reflection.strengthsEn: Good aim on a long-range hero is a bonus, but teamwork matters more than raw gunskill alone, so a player isn't entirely excluded just because one mechanical skill isn't fully developed. Character design also communicates personality and mechanics directly through build, proportions, posture, and kit.
reflection.contributionZh: 它强化了我的一个设计判断：机制和角色设计应该同时发生。一个英雄站在那里时，玩家最好已经能感受到他的行动方式、性格和技能倾向，而不是所有角色只换皮肤和特效。
reflection.contributionEn: It reinforced a design conviction of mine: mechanics and character design should happen together. When a hero is just standing there, a player should already be able to sense how they move, their personality, and their skill leanings — not have every character just be a reskin with different effects.

detail.zh: 我非常喜欢团队合作比纯准度更重要的对战设计，也很在意角色轮廓是否真正服务机制。相比统一身高、头身比和身体结构，我更喜欢让不同角色在视觉上就有明显功能差异。
detail.en: I really like combat design where teamwork matters more than raw aim, and I care a lot about whether a character's silhouette actually serves its mechanics. Rather than a uniform height, head-to-body ratio, and body structure across the roster, I prefer characters that read as functionally different from each other visually.

presentation.shortSummaryZh: 我最认可它在多端交互上的取舍：电脑端真正按单机游戏的方式重新组织体验，而不是把手游按钮原样搬上PC。

reflection.strengthsZh: 武侠大世界的整体呈现让我印象很深，尤其是PC端能够尽量减少手游式按钮和操作痕迹，让单机端拥有自己的交互逻辑。
reflection.strengthsEn: The overall presentation of its wuxia open world made a strong impression on me, especially how the PC version minimizes mobile-style buttons and touches, giving the single-player-feeling client its own interaction logic.
reflection.contributionZh: 它让我更加确定多端设计不能等于移植。很多所谓双端产品只是画面更精细，但PC端交互仍然像模拟器。我认为真正的多端未来需要针对设备重新设计信息密度、按钮和操作方式。
reflection.contributionEn: It made me even more certain that cross-platform design can't just mean porting. A lot of so-called dual-platform products just have sharper visuals while the PC interaction still feels like an emulator. I think a genuine cross-platform future needs to redesign information density, controls, and interaction methods specifically for each device.

detail.zh: 我把它作为多端交互的正面参考之一。PC端如果仍然充满手机按钮，即使画质升级也不算真正适配。我更关注同一个系统在不同设备上是否重新组织了交互，而不是有没有成功运行。
detail.en: I treat it as one of the positive references for cross-platform interaction. If the PC version is still full of mobile-style buttons, upgraded visuals alone don't count as real adaptation. I care more about whether the same system reorganizes its interaction for each device than whether it merely runs successfully on all of them.
